records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Good to see Maple Group isn't working solo anymore. How's the first week felt with another person in there?

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Still want to get Maple Group set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Group!
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Maple Group* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no first project or key milestone, and zero customer replies to three touches (email:d6ddcbcd, email:82d4ccf4, email:7629c1a6) plus a no-show call (calendar:05e9b33b). Only signal of life is one invite sent. Unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

I know launch weeks get busy, so I'll keep this brief. You've got a teammate in Wrenfield now, and the main thing left is getting a first project going "" projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so real work has somewhere to land. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to do it yourself.

If it's easier, I'm happy to set up one project with you on a short call this week "" just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
